t: The Flow Detector Tube Module is an $(l:tubes/tube_modules#inline)inline/$ module which measures the $(thing)airflow/$ through a tube. It emits a $(#f00)redstone signal/$ as result of this, using the following formula:$(p)  $(formula)0.2 * flow (mL/tick)/$$(p)E.g. with 20mL/tick of air flowing, the signal level will be 20*0.2=4.
流量检测管道模块是一种$(l:tubes/tube_modules#inline)内联/$模块，用于测量管道中的$(thing)气流/$。它会根据测得的结果输出一个$(#f00)红石信号/$，计算公式如下：$(p)  $(formula)0.2 * 流量（mL/tick）/$$(p)例如，当有 20mL/tick 的空气流动时，信号强度等级将为 20*0.2=4。

Note that $(thing)flow/$ is a different physical quantity to $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$. Flow is the amount of air traveling through a tube per tick. So if you have (say) an $(l:machines/elevators)Elevator/$ which isn't running, the flow will be 0, but when it runs it will be consuming air, so the flow will be non-zero. So this module can be used to detect if a machine is using air.$(p)The Flow Detector Module does not accept an $(l:tubes/module_expansion_card)Module Expansion Card/$.

请注意，$(thing)流量/$与$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$是不同的物理量。流量指的是每刻通过管道的空气量。因此，如果你有一台例如$(l:machines/elevators)电梯/$这样的机器，在它未运行时，流量会是 0；但当它运行时就会消耗空气，因此流量将不为 0。所以这个模块可以用来检测机器是否正在用气。$(p)流量检测模块不能安装$(l:tubes/module_expansion_card)模块拓展卡/$。
